outlooks.summary: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING FROM THE OZARKS THROUGH THE OHIO VALLEY INTO THE LOWER GREAT LAKES. ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ALSO MAY OCCUR OVER PARTS OF THE SOUTHERN PLAINS AND UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY.

sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: MODERATE CYCLONIC FLOW WILL ONCE AGAIN PREVAIL OVER THE N CNTRL STATES THIS PERIOD...ON SRN SIDE OF BROAD...SLOWLY-PROGRESSIVE ONT TROUGH. WITHIN THE TROUGH...SEVERAL SMALLER-SCALE FEATURES WILL MODULATE DIURNALLY-ENHANCED TSTM DEVELOPMENT FROM THE UPR MS VLY AND OZARKS NEWD TO THE LWR GRT LKS. STORM DEVELOPMENT PRIMARILY WILL FOCUS ALONG LEAD COLD FRONT/COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ASSOCIATED WITH THE LARGE-SCALE TROUGH. THIS BOUNDARY ATTM EXTENDS FROM THE LWR GRT LKS WSWWD THROUGH THE LWR OH VLY/NRN OZARKS INTO NE OK. FROM THERE THE BOUNDARY CONTINUES SW AND W THROUGH W TX INTO SRN NM. THE FRONT SHOULD CONTINUE SLOWLY S ACROSS THE SRN PLNS TODAY...WHILE THE PORTION OVER THE OH VLY BECOMES NRLY STNRY.

sections.title: OZARKS ENE INTO THE LWR OH VLY THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: SATELLITE AND VWP DATA SHOW AN APPARENT MCV OVER FAR ERN KS ATTM THAT MAY BE LOOSELY ASSOCIATED WITH UPSTREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW OVER SRN NEB. AS BOTH FEATURES TRACK GENERALLY E TOWARD/ACROSS THE MID MS VLY LATER TODAY...EXPECT AT LEAST MODEST ENHANCEMENT OF FORCING FOR ASCENT OVER THE OZARKS AND LWR OH VLY. STRONG SFC HEATING OF PRE-FRONTAL MOIST AXIS /PW AOA 1.75 IN/ SHOULD YIELD SBCAPE AOA 2000 J/KG FROM SRN MO/NRN AR ENE INTO SRN IL/FAR SRN IND AND PARTS OF KY/TN. COUPLED WITH RELATIVELY STEEP MID-LVL LAPSE RATES...WEAKLY CONFLUENT SWLY SFC FLOW...AND 30 KT WSWLY WINDS IN THE 700-500 MB LAYER...SETUP COULD YIELD A FEW SUSTAINED STORMS AND PERHAPS TRANSIENT ROTATING STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DMGG WIND AS THEY ORGANIZE INTO BANDS/CLUSTERS WITH EMBEDDED...SMALLER-SCALE BOWING SEGMENTS. THE STORMS SHOULD SLOWLY DIMINISH AFTER SUNSET.

sections.title: UPR OH VLY/WRN GRT LKS THIS AFTN
sections.text: FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL BE MORE LIMITED OVER THIS REGION RELATIVE TO POINTS FARTHER S AND W AS MAIN IMPULSE ASSOCIATED WITH YESTERDAY/S SVR STORMS CONTINUES NEWD ACROSS QUE. NEVERTHELESS...SUBSTANTIAL SFC HEATING AND PERSISTENT LOW-LVL MOISTURE RETURN WILL CONTINUE AHEAD OF DECELERATING COLD FRONT AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/LAKE BREEZE BOUNDARY SEGMENTS. COUPLED WITH 25-30 KT WLY MID-LVL FLOW...POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR SCTD AFTN PULSE STORM CLUSTERS WITH LOCALLY DMGG WIND.

sections.title: SRN PLNS INTO NM THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: WDLY SCTD AFTN/EARLY EVE TSTMS ARE EXPECTED ALONG FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY NEARING THE RED RVR...AND IN POST-FRONTAL UPSLOPE FLOW OVER CNTRL/ERN NM. DEEP SHEAR AND LOW-LVL FLOW APPEAR TOO WEAK TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED/SUSTAINED STORMS. BUT GIVEN DEGREE OF BUOYANCY /POCKETS OF SBCAPE TO 2000 J PER KG AMIDST STEEP LOW TO MID-LVL LAPSE RATES/...A CONDITIONAL RISK WILL EXIST FOR LOCALLY DMGG WIND AND HAIL. A FEW ELEVATED STORMS WITH SPORADIC HAIL COULD PERSIST THROUGH THE NIGHT N OF THE FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES OVER THE SRN PLNS.

sections.title: UPR/MID MS VLY THIS AFTN/EARLY EVE
sections.text: WDLY SCTD...RELATIVELY LOW-TOPPED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTN OVER PARTS OF IA...IL...WI...AND SE MN. DEVELOPMENT WILL OCCUR IN RESPONSE TO SFC HEATING...AND WILL BE FOSTERED BY ASCENT WITH SD SHORTWAVE IMPULSE ROTATING SEWD WITHIN LARGER-SCALE TROUGH. SECONDARY COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPR IMPULSE SHOULD BE THE MAIN FOCUS FOR DEVELOPMENT. WHILE DEEP WLY FLOW WILL LIMIT LOW-LVL CONVERGENCE...PRESENCE OF COOL MID-LVL TEMPS /AROUND MINUS 11 C AT 500 MB/ AMIDST STRONG SFC HEATING AND MODERATE FORCING FOR ASCENT MAY YIELD A FEW SUSTAINED/ORGANIZED STORMS CAPABLE OF ISOLD SVR WIND AND HAIL GIVEN 50-80 KT 500-300 MB FLOW. THE STORMS SHOULD WEAKEN FAIRLY RAPIDLY AFTER SUNSET. ..CORFIDI/SMITH.. 07/01/2014

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING FROM THE OZARKS THROUGH THE OHIO VALLEY INTO THE LOWER GREAT LAKES. ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ALSO MAY OCCUR OVER PARTS OF THE SOUTHERN PLAINS. REMOVED SEVERE PROBABILITIES FROM THE UPPER MS VALLEY AREA AS IT APPEARS POOR LAPSE RATES WILL LEAD TO SLOW-GROWING UPDRAFTS ONLY CAPABLE OF SMALL HAIL. VISIBLE SATELLITE TRENDS FURTHER SUGGEST WEAK STORMS AND SHOWERY STORM MODE SUGGESTING IT WILL BE DIFFICULT TO PRODUCE SEVERE WIND GUSTS. OTHERWISE...NO OTHER CHANGES TO THE PREVIOUS OUTLOOK. ..JEWELL.. 07/01/2014 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1121 AM CDT TUE JUL 01 2014/

DEVELOPMENT WILL OCCUR IN RESPONSE TO SFC HEATING...AND WILL BE FOSTERED BY ASCENT WITH SD SHORTWAVE IMPULSE ROTATING SEWD WITHIN LARGER-SCALE TROUGH. mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS...SOME BECOMING SEVERE WITH DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL...ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP LATE THIS MORNING INTO THE AFTERNOON FROM NWRN PA AND WRN NY AND DEVELOP/SPREAD EWD INTO NORTH-CENTRAL PA...AND CENTRAL TO UPSTATE NY. INITIAL STORMS SHOULD FORM ALONG A LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ZONE...ENHANCED SOME BY THE SRN-ERN LAKE ERIE LAKE BREEZE...WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS DEVELOPING ALONG A MORE WELL-DEFINED WIND SHIFT/COLD FRONT MOVING INTO WRN NY BY 18Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MIDLEVEL IMPULSE PER TRENDS IN WATER VAPOR IMAGERY WAS MOVING THROUGH CENTRAL/SRN ONTARIO...APPROACHING SWRN QUEBEC LATE THIS MORNING. A COLD FRONT ATTENDANT TO THIS IMPULSE EXTENDED FROM SWRN QUEBEC THROUGH SERN ONTARIO TO NEAR TORONTO...AND INTO WRN LAKE ERIE. ONGOING TSTMS WERE LOCATED ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE ONTARIO PORTION OF THIS FRONT...THUS FAR. MEANWHILE...THE AIR MASS FROM THE UPPER OH VALLEY TO UPSTATE NY WAS UNDERGOING DESTABILIZATION...GIVEN THE LACK OF SUBSTANTIAL PRE-FRONTAL CLOUD COVER ALLOWING FOR RISING SURFACE TEMPERATURES WITHIN A MOISTURE RICH BOUNDARY LAYER. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED LATE MORNING MLCAPE RANGED FROM 1500-2000 J/KG ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. WEAK CAPPING PER BUF 12Z SOUNDING HAS BEEN ERODED AS CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURES INTO THE MIDDLE 80S ARE RESULTING IN CU/TCU DEVELOPMENT ALONG A COUPLE OF LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE BOUNDARIES EXTENDING FROM NERN OH/NWRN PA INTO FAR WRN NY. TSTM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE POSSIBLE ALONG THESE BOUNDARIES AND INVOF THE COLD FRONT AS IT ADVANCES EWD...REACHING FAR WRN WY /NEAR BUF METRO AREA BY 18Z/. DESPITE MODERATE INSTABILITY SUPPORTING TSTM DEVELOPMENT INVOF THE SURFACE BOUNDARIES...NEGATIVE FACTORS POTENTIALLY LIMITING GREATER SEVERE WEATHER COVERAGE INCLUDE 1/ WEAK FORCING ALOFT AS THE ONTARIO/QUEBEC IMPULSE MOVES NEWD AWAY FROM THE LOWER GREAT LAKES...AND 2/ STRONGER FLOW ALOFT REMAINING N AND NW OF THE DISCUSSION AREA. HOWEVER...MODEST DEEP LAYER SHEAR OF 25-30 KT SHOULD RESULT IN PRIMARILY A MULTICELL STORM MODE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS SOUTH CENTRAL MO INTO ADJACENT NWRN AR...WITH ACTIVITY SPREADING EWD THROUGH SRN MO...NRN AR TO THE LOWER OH VALLEY. DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS WITH WW ISSUANCE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATED AN INCREASING CU FIELD EARLY THIS AFTERNOON FROM SOUTH CENTRAL MO INTO NWRN AR WITH CLOUD APPEARANCE SUGGESTING UPDRAFTS HAD TENDED TO BE SUPPRESSED SOME /I.E. INDICATIVE OF A CAP PRESENT IN THIS REGION/. HOWEVER...LIGHTNING DATA SHOWED STRIKES IN SOUTHWEST-SOUTH CENTRAL MO...LIKELY ATTENDANT TO WEAKENING INHIBITION/CAP. ADDITIONAL STORM INITIATION SHOULD OCCUR IN VICINITY OF THE MO PORTION OF A SURFACE WIND SHIFT THAT EXTENDED FROM SOUTH CENTRAL IL THROUGH EAST CENTRAL TO SWRN MO INTO NERN OK. THIS INITIATION /SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS/ WILL BE FURTHER AIDED BY FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO A MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH CURRENTLY MOVING EWD THROUGH MO TOWARD THE MID MS VALLEY. VWP DATA PER SGF WSR-88D DETECTED 50-60 KT AT 5-6 KM AGL AND IS LIKELY ATTENDANT TO THE MO SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THIS WILL ENHANCE EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...RANGING FROM 30-45 KT...WITH THE WEAKER VALUES EXPECTED INTO NRN AR. THIS SHEAR AND A STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT /MLCAPE 2000-3000 J PER KG/ ARE MORE THAN SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT MULTICELLS AND PERHAPS TRANSIENT ROTATING STRUCTURES. MOST SHORT-TERM MODELS SUPPORT AN INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...SUGGESTING WATCH ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON FROM PARTS OF NY AND PA INTO ERN OH. SEVERE TSTM WATCH ISSUANCE REMAINS POSSIBLE...BUT OVERALL COVERAGE OF SEVERE WEATHER IS UNCERTAIN RESULTING IN THE PROBABILITY FOR WATCH ISSUANCE BEING 40 PERCENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LIKELIHOOD FOR WATCH ISSUANCE IS GREATER WITH NWD EXTENT INTO UPSTATE NY...GIVEN CLOSER PROXIMITY TO GREATER DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE SRN EXTENT/GLANCING EFFECTS OF A TROUGH MOVING THROUGH SRN QUEBEC. LIGHTNING DATA AND MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED TSTMS HAVE CONTINUED TO DEVELOP ALONG A BOUNDARY MOVING EWD ACROSS NY...WITH MOST RECENT ACTIVITY EXTENDING FROM THE ERN SHORE OF LAKE ONTARIO THROUGH CENTRAL NY...NWRN PA...AND EAST CENTRAL OH. ADDITIONAL STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG THE HIGHER TERRAIN IN CENTRAL PA. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWED A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH SRN QUEBEC WITH THE SRN EXTENT OF THIS MIDLEVEL FEATURE MOVING THROUGH NRN NY RESULTING IN WEAK HEIGHT FALLS IN THE NRN EXTENT OF THE DISCUSSION AREA. MOISTURE RETURN COMBINED WITH DIABATIC HEATING HAS RESULTED IN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT FROM THE OH VALLEY TO UPSTATE NY. WHILE ADDITIONAL STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGHOUT THE DISCUSSION AREA...THE NRN PORTION ACROSS UPSTATE NY MAY HAVE THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR WATCH ISSUANCE /HIGHER SEVERE WEATHER THREAT/...GIVEN THE PROXIMITY TO STRONGER SWLY MIDLEVEL FLOW /30-40 KT/ ENHANCING DEEP LAYER SHEAR FOR STORM ORGANIZATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THERE WILL EXIST A RISK FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS INTO THE EVENING HOURS. WHILE WW ISSUANCE IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...CONVECTIVE AND ENVIRONMENTAL TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED THROUGHOUT THE EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VIS IMAGERY INDICATES A 70-MILE WIDE ZONE OF BOUNDARY-LAYER CUMULUS IN PROXIMITY TO A STALLED FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ANALYZED FROM N-CNTRL AR TO WICHITA FALLS TX TO THE TX S PLAINS. FRONTAL ASCENT COUPLED WITH DIURNALLY ENCOURAGED REMOVAL OF MLCINH SHOULD FOSTER A CONTINUED UPTICK IN CONVECTION. STRENGTHENING STORMS ARE ALREADY NOTED E OF WICHITA FALLS AND NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF THE FRONT AND ANOTHER BOUNDARY EXTENDING WNWWD ACROSS THE LOW ROLLING PLAINS AND TX S PLAINS. WITH TEMPERATURES HAVING CLIMBED INTO THE LOWER 90S AMIDST UPPER 60S/LOWER 70S DEWPOINTS...A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS EXISTS ACROSS THE REGION. FDR VWP INDICATES MODEST MID-LEVEL FLOW -- AROUND 20-30 KT -- WHICH MAY FOSTER A FEW PERSISTENT MULTICELL CLUSTERS. ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS AND SVR HAIL WILL BE THE GREATEST CONCERNS ACROSS THE REGION. HOWEVER...WITH DEEP FORCING FOR ASCENT RATHER LIMITED...AND WITHOUT STRONGER DEEP SHEAR OR A STRENGTHENING LLJ...PROSPECTS FOR MORE ORGANIZED/UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH AND LARGER COLD POOL GENERATION APPEAR LIMITED. REGARDLESS...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED INTO THE EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE DEVELOPING NEWD THROUGH NRN KY...SRN IND AND SWRN OH THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING. THE STRONGER STORMS WILL POSE A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS EVENING A SLOW MOVING COLD FRONT EXTENDS FROM WRN OH SWWD THROUGH SRN IND...SRN IL AND SERN MO. STRONG DIABATIC WARMING OF THE VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER /LOW 70F DEWPOINTS/ HAS RESULTED IN STRONG INSTABILITY IN PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR. TREND HAS BEEN FOR STORMS TO DEVELOP NEWD ALONG THE FRONT AND WITHIN THE LOW-LEVEL PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENT FLOW REGIME. ACTIVITY RESIDES SOUTH OF THE STRONGER WINDS ALOFT WITH MODEST UNIDIRECTIONAL WLY DEEP LAYER FLOW AND 20-30 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF MULTICELLS. THE STORMS DEVELOPING OVER SERN MO AND SRN IL /CURRENTLY IN WW 383/ ARE IN THE PROCESS OF CONSOLIDATING INTO A LINE AND WILL SUBSEQUENTLY ADVANCE EWD...POSING A SOMEWHAT MORE ORGANIZED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR VERY ISOLATED SVR STORMS WILL EXIST INTO THE EVENING HOURS...AND WW ISSUANCE IS NOT NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOIST...UPSLOPE FLOW BEHIND A FRONT THAT HAS SETTLED SWD IS ENHANCING STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER PORTIONS OF SRN NM...WITH MORE ISOLATED STORMS ALONG THE SAME FRONT EXTENDING EWD INTO PARTS OF THE TX S PLAINS AND THE PERMIAN BASIN. WHILE CONTINUED STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE AS MLCINH IS LIMITED...THE REGION IS DISPLACED TO THE SW OF ANY SUBSTANTIVE FORCING FOR ASCENT ACCOMPANYING AN UPPER TROUGH CROSSING THE N-CNTRL STATES. ALSO...WITH A DEARTH OF DEEP SHEAR...STORMS SHOULD PRIMARILY EXHIBIT PULSE CHARACTERISTICS. REGARDLESS...THE PRESENCE OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY AND DCAPE AROUND 1000-1500 J/KG COULD FOSTER INTENSE DOWNBURSTS WITH VERY ISOLATED SVR WINDS POSSIBLE. STORMS WILL WEAKEN AFTER SUNSET AS STATIC STABILITY INCREASES WITHIN THE BOUNDARY LAYER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL PERSIST NEXT FEW HOURS...WITH GREATEST THREAT POSSIBLY ACROSS WRN KY THROUGH 00Z. ANY WW EAST OF WW 383 WILL DEPEND ON SHORT TERM CONVECTIVE TRENDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE CONSOLIDATED INTO A SOLID LINE THAT EXTENDS FROM SRN IND TO SRN IL...SERN MO AND NERN ARKANSAS. THE LINE IS MOVING ESEWD AT 25-30 KT AND IS APPROACHING WRN KY. WARM SECTOR REMAINS VERY UNSTABLE WITH 2500-3000 J/KG MLCAPE...BUT STORMS ARE EMBEDDED WITHING MODEST UNIDIRECTIONAL FLOW LARGELY PARALLEL TO MOST OF THE LINE WHICH MAY BE A LIMITING FACTOR FOR MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WIND. THE STORMS MOVING INTO WRN KY IMMEDIATELY SOUTH OF WEAK CIRCULATION OVER SRN IL IS ORIENTED AT A SLIGHTLY LARGER ANGLE TO THE DEEP LAYER WINDS WHICH MIGHT INCREASE THE POTENTIAL FOR BOWING SEGMENTS. ..DIAL.. 07/01/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE IN THE PROCESS OF EXITING SRN PORTIONS OF WW 383. WHILE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL MAY PERSIST THROUGH AROUND 02Z...OVERALL THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BECOME INCREASINGLY MARGINAL AND ANOTHER WW WILL PROBABLY NOT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EXTENSIVE SQUALL LINE FROM NERN ARKANSAS THROUGH NWRN TN...WRN AND NRN KY CONTINUES DEVELOPING SEWD. STORMS ARE EMBEDDED WITHIN WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR AND DEEP LAYER WINDS LARGELY PARALLEL TO THE LINE WHICH APPEARS TO HAVE LIMITED THE SEVERE THREAT TO SOME DEGREE. ISOLATED INSTANCES OF STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS MAY STILL OCCUR NEXT COUPLE HOURS...BUT WITH ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING...OVERALL THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BEGIN A GRADUAL DECREASE. ..DIAL.. 07/02/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG STORMS MAY AFFECT PORTIONS OF THE MIDDLE AND UPPER OHIO VALLEY THIS EVENING...THOUGH WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF STORMS DEVELOPING NEWD INTO SWRN/CNTRL OHIO ARE CONGEALING WITHIN THE NRN FLANK OF A BROADER MCS WHOSE LEADING CONVECTIVE LINE EXTENDS SWWD INTO THE MID-SOUTH. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD EWD INTO THE EVENING HOURS AIDED BY 20-30 KT OF MID-LEVEL FLOW -- STRONGEST STEERING-LAYER FLOW N OF THE OHIO RIVER PER AREA RAOBS/VWPS. WHILE THE WILMINGTON OHIO 00Z RAOB SAMPLES AROUND 2000 J/KG OF MLCAPE...THE CONVECTIVE-LINE-PARALLEL ORIENTATION TO THE MID-LEVEL FLOW SUGGESTS THAT RELATED OUTFLOW WILL HAVE A TENDENCY OF OUTPACING PARENT CONVECTION YIELDING AN ANAFRONTAL FLOW REGIME REDUCING ANY SVR RISK. MEANWHILE...NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION SHOULD BE DELETERIOUS TO PROLONGED MAINTENANCE OF STRONGER CONVECTION...ESPECIALLY AS STORMS REACH/CROSS THE OHIO RIVER. REGARDLESS...ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS AND SMALL HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN EXTENSIVE SQUALL LINE WILL CONTINUE TO WEAKEN AS IT CROSSES PORTIONS OF THE MID-SOUTH AND THE TN VALLEY REGION...THOUGH A FEW STRONG STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE. THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS NOT NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN MCS FROM CNTRL/WRN KY TO NERN AR EXHIBITS PRINCIPAL FORWARD PROPAGATION OVER S-CNTRL KY AND ADJACENT MIDDLE TN WITH THE TRAILING CONVECTIVE LINE EXTENDING WWD ACROSS WRN TN INTO FAR NERN AR. THE MAJORITY OF THIS LINE HAS BECOME PARALLEL TO MID-LEVEL WLYS OF 20-25 KT PER AREA VWPS AND 00Z BNA RAOB...WITH PRIMARY SEWD/SWD MOTION ACROSS TN AND NERN AR DRIVEN BY PROPAGATION INTO MODERATELY/STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR. AS THE PRE-CONVECTIVE AIR MASS EXPERIENCES NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION WHILE LOW-LEVEL FLOW REMAINS WEAK...STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO WEAKEN. HOWEVER...A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT -- ESPECIALLY ALONG THE KY/TN BORDER -- IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS CROSSING PORTIONS OF WRN NY AND NRN PA COULD PRODUCE A STRONG WIND GUST. A WW IS NOT NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION HAS LOOSELY ORGANIZED INTO A SQUALL LINE FROM WRN NY INTO NWRN PA IN ADVANCE OF A LOW-AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE IMPULSE CROSSING THE LOWER GREAT LAKES REGION...AIDED BY MOIST INFLOW /E.G. SFC DEWPOINTS AROUND 70F/. HOWEVER...MODIFICATIONS TO THE 00Z BUFFALO AND PITTSBURGH RAOBS SUGGEST ONLY MODEST BUOYANCY REMAINS BUT WITH AMPLE MLCINH AS STATIC STABILITY CONTINUES TO NOCTURNALLY GROW WITHIN THE BOUNDARY LAYER. WHILE AN ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUST CANNOT BE RULED OUT WITH THESE STORMS AIDED BY CONVECTIVE MOMENTUM TRANSPORT OF 20-35 KT OF WLYS/WSWLYS IN THE 1-3-KM LAYER...DOWNDRAFT PENETRATION INTO THE STABLE PBL WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY UNLIKELY AS FURTHER NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION. FURTHERMORE...THE LACK OF STRONGER DEEP ASCENT AND LACK OF A MORE ESTABLISHED COLD POOL WILL GREATLY OFFSET ANY SVR RISK.
